axis_semantics.x: mean fresh cold end-to-end wall time in seconds
axis_semantics.x_interval: minimum to maximum across three repeats
axis_semantics.y: aggregate RMSE against the fixed high-budget reference

figure_claim: Accuracy-efficiency is compared using fresh measured cold end-to-end runtime rather than a utility-call proxy.
qa_notes: The 8.9-inch square working export intentionally follows the requested near-square layout rather than a journal column width.
PNG is the raster preview; PDF and SVG are the editable publication masters, so no TIFF preview is duplicated here.
All plotted wall times and RMSE bounds pass explicit finite, strictly-positive validation before log scaling.

statistics.repeat_unit: independent method-budget run with a fresh pool
statistics.y_center: RMSE of the repeat-mean Shapley vector
